title: Create a governed RFx draft
intro: Choose the request type that best fits the market conversation you need to begin. Your organization owns every draft created here.
privateDraftDetail: Drafts are not published, visible on the map, discoverable, matched, or sent to responders.
permissionBody: Your current organization role does not permit RFx creation. No draft information has been disclosed.
nextBoundary: Need, scope, location, value, requirements, readiness, and publication become available only in later governed steps.
createBody: This first action creates only the private RFx kernel and its governed request-type snapshot.
changed: Request type updated with a new draft version.
recovered: The previously completed RFx change was recovered without duplication.
error: The RFx action could not be completed.
packageSaved: RFx package saved with a new draft version.
packageBoundary: Saving updates this private draft only. It does not publish or create market activity.
needHelp: Describe the business condition and target outcome before prescribing a solution.
sourceStatement: What do you need the market to help with?
interpretBoundary: Optional suggestions only; your review and a separate save are required.
interpretNeedsSource: Enter a source statement before requesting suggestions.
interpretUnavailable: Suggestions are unavailable. Continue with the manual builder.
interpretRecorded: Your review was recorded. No RFx field changed automatically.
locationUnavailable: Confirm an organization location before adding a performance location.
locationBoundary: Operational location stays private in this draft; publication visibility is a separate governed decision.
requirementsBoundary: Add only foundation requirements here. Capability qualifiers, response sections, evaluation factors, and readiness come later.
